addFreeServersSubtitle: We'll find working ones in public lists
addLinkHint: Several links work too — one per line
additionalProxySubtitle: On top of the main: traffic → main proxy → this
advancedSettingsSubtitle: VLESS engine, URL schemes, config editing
allowConfigEditingSubtitle: The location editor shows every configuration parameter for fine-tuning (AmneziaWG: Jc, Jmin, Jmax, S1–S4, H1–H4, I1–I5 and more). A wrong value breaks the tunnel
allowInstallUpdates: Allow YPtun to install updates, then tap Download again
appIconHint: The home-screen icon changes in a couple of seconds. If your launcher keeps the old one or drops it, add the app to the home screen again.
autoConnectSubtitle: Connect to the selected config when the app opens
autoInstallOrManual: Or fill in the fields below by hand
autoInstallText: We'll connect to your VPS over SSH, install the server and fill in the fields below. All it takes is the IP and the password.
autoInstallTitle: Install the server on a VPS
awgTuningHint: Values must match the server. An empty field means the parameter is not set. Changes apply when the location is saved
batteryOptSubtitle: Keeps the VPN alive in the background over long idle hours. Opens system settings
blockRuDomainsSubtitle: Bundled list of Russian domains → 0.0.0.0. Requires the Xray core.
bypassRussiaSubtitle: RU sites & IPs go direct (geoip + geosite)
confirmDeleteSubtitle: Ask before deleting subscriptions and configs
coreSubtitle: Auto picks Xray for xhttp, otherwise sing-box
createCustomLocationSubtitle: Enter room, key, provider, and transport
deleteAllConfigsMessage: All configurations and subscriptions will be removed. This cannot be undone.
deleteAllSubscriptionsMessage: All subscription configurations will be removed. Custom locations are kept.
deleteDuplicatesMessage: Duplicate custom locations with identical configuration will be removed (one copy kept). Subscriptions are not touched.
deleteLocationMessage: This location will be removed. This cannot be undone.
deleteSubscriptionMessage: All configurations of this subscription ({count}) will be removed.
deleteUnreachableMessage: Custom locations that were unreachable on the last ping will be removed. Subscriptions are not touched.
dnsFormatsHint: Plain IP, or DoH/DoT/DoQ: https://dns.google/dns-query, tls://1.1.1.1, quic://dns.adguard-dns.com
donateSubtitle: USDT · TON · GRAM — tap to copy the address
energySaverSubtitle: Lower battery use: less frequent health checks, no journal. May slow auto-recovery; applied on next connect
engineChainDesc: Your proxy inside the olcRTC tunnel
engineMasterDnsDesc: A tunnel over DNS queries — for when only DNS gets through
engineOpenFluxDesc: Through Yandex Docs or a MAX call to your own node
engineSnolcDesc: An encrypted TCP tunnel to your own node
engineStandardDesc: VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks — from a link or a subscription
engineStealthDesc: A tunnel through a video call room: Telemost, Jazz, MTS Link, VK Calls, Jitsi
engineVkTurnDesc: WireGuard over VK call TURN servers
engineWireguardDesc: A .conf file or keys by hand
everyAppSameRoute: Every app follows the same TUN route
fakeDnsSubtitle: Answers DNS with synthetic IPs — apps never see the real address; the domain is resolved behind the proxy. A subscription config with its own fakedns is used as-is.
folderDeleteMessage: The group will be removed. Its locations and subscriptions are not deleted — they return to the main list.
folderEmpty: Group is empty — add locations via long-press
freeServersDisclaimer: Public servers expire quickly. It is recommended to periodically clean old ones and add fresh servers.
freeServersLimitSubtitle: How many servers «Free servers» may take: the first N by source priority. More means a longer check.
freeServersPagesSubtitle: Take free servers from one combined list (up to 20,000 vless links harvested from GitHub, refreshed hourly). Off — the built-in sources
freeServersSourceNotice: Servers come from public lists on GitHub and have nothing to do with the YPtun developers — we neither create nor control them. Use at your own risk.
freeServersSubtitle: Public server lists — download & filter working
freeServersWaitNotice: Searching and testing servers may take some time, please wait…
freeServersWarpAllHint: Recommended for free servers: traffic leaves through Cloudflare WARP instead of straight from a stranger's server (safer). AmneziaWG for Russian servers, WireGuard for the rest. Use a row's cloud to turn it off.
freeturnTransportSubtitle: VK TURN relay endpoint and obfuscation
globalEngineSubtitle: Core for VLESS-like transports when a server's setting is "Auto". The per-server choice overrides this. xhttp always uses Xray.
hideEndpointWhenDescriptionSubtitle: If a location has a description, show it instead of the protocol and IP at the connection point.
hideModuleFailed: Couldn't install the module (root + Zygisk required)
hideModuleRebootMessage: The hide module is installed. A reboot is required for hiding to take effect. Reboot now?
hideSessionButtonSubtitle: Remove the Session button from the home screen
hideSshInstallSubtitle: Remove the install-on-VPS buttons from the server screen
hideTunDisclaimer: Warning: this uses root access (su). The software author is NOT liable for any damage, data loss, or harm to your device resulting from root usage.
hideTunSubtitle: Installs a Zygisk module that hides the VPN interface from other apps. Requires root (Magisk) and a reboot.
importHint: Scan QR, paste URI, or import file
legacyUiSubtitle: The previous look of settings, the home screen and the server screen
lightThemeOn: White canvas, system dark theme ignored
listViewSubtitle: How the home screen and the server list look
lockedLocationNotice: This connection comes from an encrypted subscription: addresses, tokens and keys are hidden and cannot be copied. You can remove it from the list.
manualIntro: Pick what the traffic goes through. The fields for it come next.
manualLinkNote: VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks and Hysteria2 are added by link — paste it on the previous screen.
noAppsHint: Install launchable apps to configure routing rules.
noMatchHint: Try another app name or package.
noSubscriptionsSubtitle: Imported HTTPS subscriptions will appear here.
notifAddVkLink: Add a VK call link first
notifPingSubtitle: On: ping on its own line above the speed. Off: after the server name
notifSpeedSubtitle: Show download ↓ and upload ↑ in the shade
notifVkCaptcha: VK asks for a captcha — tap to solve
notificationsSettingsSubtitle: Speed and ping in the shade, subscription expiry
notifySubExpirySubtitle: Local notification a few days before the subscription ends.
otherVpnDetectedBody: Another VPN client already seems to be running ({names}). It holds the network adapter and can keep this connection from starting. Close it?
panelAnnouncementsSubtitle: Show a system notification when the panel owner sends an announcement.
pingPrecisionSubtitle: How many times to measure: the best time is shown. A server that does not answer the first time is not re-measured.
pingThreadsSubtitle: How many locations to probe at once (1–30) — for ping and the Auto button
pingTimeoutSubtitle: How long to wait for a server's answer (2–15 s)
providerReportDetails: If a provider adds a providerid header to a subscription (Remnawave and Happ panels do), the app sends a request to check.happ-proxy.com/provider once a day. It carries: the provider ID, the device identifier (HWID), the app ID, the OS and its version, the device model and the app version. Subscriptions work without this report. When off, that request is never sent. Refreshing a subscription still passes device details to the panel: it needs them for its device limit.
providerReportSubtitle: Tell the provider once a day that the subscription is in use
proxyManualSetup: No GNOME/KDE to set the system proxy — point your browser at HTTP proxy {httpHostPort}
proxyOverVkturnSubtitle: Chain a vless/vmess/trojan/ss proxy on top of the WireGuard tunnel
proxySectionSubtitle: Paste a vless/vmess/trojan/ss link, an AmneziaWG config, or a sing-box outbound JSON
qrNotRecognized: No QR code found in that image
qrTooLarge: Config is too large for a QR code. Use Copy or Share instead.
renameSubscriptionHint: An empty name restores the original
roomsInNotifSubtitle: Show «connected/total» rooms (olcRTC multi-room) or servers (VK-TURN freeturn multi-server)
routingExpertDesc: Fine-tune routing separately for Xray and sing-box
routingExpertResolveDesc: Resolve the domain to an IP so geoip:/ip rules can match.
routingExpertRouteOnlyDesc: Detect the domain for routing only, but still dial the original address.
routingExpertSniffingDesc: Required for domain:/geosite: rules to match by SNI/Host. Without it .ru rules do nothing.
routingGeoDatabasesDesc: Needed for geoip:/geosite: selectors on the Xray core. Downloaded from the sources below.
routingProfileGlobalHint: Applied to every connection unless a location sets its own profile
routingProfileGlobalProxyDesc: Otherwise direct, except the “via proxy” lists
routingProfilesSubtitle: Happ-compatible rules — globally or per location
routingRulesDesc: A custom v2rayNG-style rule list. Runs on the sing-box core; rules apply top to bottom.
routingRulesEmpty: No rules yet. Add the first one.
routingShareAllDesc: Copy every profile as one yptun://routing link, or paste one to import.
routingSubtitle: Bypass LAN/Russia, block ads, custom domains
savePingResultsSubtitle: Show the last results again when the app is reopened
secondProxySameAsMain: This is the same server as the main proxy — a cascade into itself makes no sense
securedSocksProxySubtitle: Username and password on a port of your choosing
sendDeviceInfoSubtitle: HWID, app ID, OS and device model. Off: none of it is sent, but a subscription with a device limit may be refused
sessionFailed: Could not load the data. Check your connection
sessionNote: Your IP address is a unique identifier of your connection to the Internet, like a return address on a letter. The data is requested only when this window is opened.
setSystemProxyOff: System settings are left alone — point only the apps you want at the proxy address
setSystemProxyOn: The proxy is set system-wide — browsers and apps use it automatically
shareHotspotDisclaimer: Warning: this uses root access (su) and changes routing/iptables rules. The software author is NOT liable for any damage.
shareHotspotSubtitle: Routes devices connected to your hotspot through the VPN. Turn on the hotspot and connect the VPN. Requires root.
shareScanOrCopy: Scan the QR code or copy the link
shareUniversalLinkSubtitle: On: a yptun:// link carrying the whole location (engine, proxy, settings). Off: the link of the specific protocol (vless://, freeturn://, …); OpenFlux, Snolc and MasterDNS have no link of their own, so they still share yptun://
showAliveCountSubtitle: Show "live/total" in the subscription header from the last ping pass
showAutoButtonSubtitle: Round button next to Connect — pings all servers and connects to the fastest
showGroupAutoPickSubtitle: Button on a subscription, folder or custom list — pings its servers and connects to the fastest
showGroupAutoPickTitle: Fastest-server button on subscriptions and groups
showPingControlsSubtitle: Show pause/stop buttons while pinging and the "Tested N of M" line under the subscription
showSubscriptionDescriptionSubtitle: Show the panel's text (announce) under the subscription name
showSubscriptionExpirySubtitle: Show "until dd.mm.yyyy" under the refresh date
showSubscriptionIconsSubtitle: The panel's icon to the left of the subscription name
speedOnHomeSubtitle: Show ↓ and ↑ under the selected configuration
speedTestFailed: The test failed. Check your connection
subscriptionCascadeHint: Proxy link (vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss://). It becomes the second proxy of every server in the subscription and survives refreshes. Empty — remove
subscriptionCascadeRejected: Cascade rejected: a working proxy link is needed (vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss://)
subscriptionForAllServers: For every server of the subscription
subscriptionJsonEmpty: Nothing to copy: the subscription servers cannot be expressed as JSON
subscriptionLinkHint: New link (http/https). Servers, names and settings are kept and the subscription refreshes from it right away.
subscriptionLinkReadOnlyHint: This subscription's link cannot be changed
subscriptionLinkRejected: Link rejected: it must be an http/https address that no other subscription uses
subscriptionUserAgentSubtitle: What the app calls itself in requests to the subscription panel. By default there are two requests: the main one as YPtun (clean names and links) and a second as Happ/1.0 (the server's FakeDNS config, and the fallback when a panel refuses YPtun). “Happ” is one request as Happ/1.0. “YPtun” is one request as YPtun, the app never presents as Happ (no FakeDNS from the panel). “v2rayTun” is one request as v2raytun/<platform>.
subscriptionsUpdateFailed: Couldn't update subscriptions — check your connection
supportGithubStarHint: A free way to help the project
supportProjectThanks: The project lives on your support — thank you!
supportVpnSubHint: Buy VPN from the author and support the project · Telegram @quofortpostbot
telegramProxyRegionNote: ⚠️ Works in some regions only (mainly Russia) and not on every ISP.
telegramProxySubtitle: Background SOCKS5 for Telegram. First enable needs internet — then set the address in Telegram's proxy settings (or tap "Open Telegram").
telemostCookiesDescription: Cookies of a signed-in Yandex account (the Cookie header, e.g. "Session_id=…; yandexuid=…") — for private conferences. A custom core cannot be launched as a separate binary on Android, so this feature is built into the stock core.
tunNeedsAdminBody: Tunnel mode creates a network adapter and rewrites the routing table, which needs administrator rights. YPtun will restart and ask for them. Proxy mode works without them.
twoColumnLayoutSubtitle: Show the configuration list on the home screen as a two-column grid.
useFragmentSubtitle: Splits TLS packets to evade DPI. Requires the Xray core.
useMuxSubtitle: Faster, but may reduce connection stability
useTelemostCookiesSubtitle: Attach cookies when connecting to Telemost
vkCallLinkBody: Paste your VK Calls join link for "{name}". You can paste several links (one per line) to spread the tunnel across calls for more speed.
vkCallLinksSubtitle: Personal VK Calls join link (required). Add up to 5 — each extra call adds bandwidth (the tunnel is spread across them).
vpsAutoInstallSubtitle: Deploys the engine onto a VPS.
warpProtocolAwgSubtitle: AmneziaWG with obfuscation — works where WireGuard is blocked
warpProtocolWgSubtitle: Plain WireGuard (official Cloudflare registration). Some ISPs' DPI blocks it
warpSubtitle: Go out to the internet through Cloudflare WARP
wireguardSubtitle: The tunnel sing-box dials through the local freeturn listener
